copy.heading: Your padel budget
body: The engagement does not ask you to stop talking about padel altogether. That would be unrealistic, and Lauren says it would also be eerie. Instead, you will be given a daily padel budget: a fixed number of mentions to spend as you see fit.
Spend it wisely. A mention used on the group chat is still a mention. A mention used on the midwife is a waste. Unspent mentions cannot be carried over to the weekend.
